text:
Ava G.: Heads-up: BrightCore just used the marketplace 'claim_token' flow to mark 6 accounts as 'claimed' and our pipeline attribution got messy. We should lock down the claim lifecycle and define stitching rules so commission and pipeline metrics stay sane.

Jon K.: Oh no — which accounts and what went wrong?

Ava G.: acct_3010 (POC), acct_3021 (demo), acct_3033 (named account), acct_3034 (overlap w/partner AM). They left claim_state=claimed which auto-created an opportunity owner change and duplicated forecast entries.

Priya S.: Marketplace should only produce a 'reservation' not a direct owner flip unless Partnerships ACKs. We need: claim_token with TTL, states [reserved, pending_confirm, assigned], and a stitching policy for territorial overlaps.

Luca (BrightCore): Sorry folks. In our UX we surface a toggle "claim account" that emits claim_token and we expected a manual handshake. We'll pause outreach until you advise.

Ava G.: Proposed immediate guardrails:
- claim_token behavior: token issued -> sets claim_state=reserved for 72h, does NOT change SF owner
- if SI submits customer_signed_ack with token, state -> pending_confirm (48h Partnerships review)
- Partnerships sets state -> assigned (Redwood_lead / SI_lead / Joint)
- Stitch policy: if account territory overlaps, create joint-play with percent_split field (e.g., 70/30) and attribution tags

Priya S.: I'll add a CRM automation. Draft YAML: 
```yaml
trigger: marketplace_claim_token_issued
actions:
  - set_field: claim_state=reserved
  - set_ttl: 72h
  - notify: [partnerships, owner]

trigger: marketplace_claim_token_redeemed
actions:
  - set_field: claim_state=pending_confirm
  - notify: [partnerships]
  - create_task: review_claim
  - revert_if_no_action: 48h
```

Jon K.: Good. Also add an event for analytics: claim_impact_report to ensure pipeline/forecast deduping happens (so duplicates are merged under joint-play if assigned).

Ava G.: Also add a small matrix for account mapping so next time we can auto-resolve:
CSV example:
acct_id,territory,prev_owner,si_claiming,claim_state,percent_split
acct_3010,NA-manufacturing,jon@example.com,brightcore@,reserved,0
acct_3033,EMEA-retail,leah@example.com,brightcore@,pending_confirm,50/50

Luca (BrightCore): We'll update our marketplace UX to make claim_token TTL explicit and surface "this does not change Salesforce owner until partnerships confirms". Apologies for the churn.

ops-automation: Automated task created: review_claim for acct_3010, acct_3021, acct_3033, acct_3034. Assignees: partnerships, field. Deadline: 48h.

Priya S.: I'll stage the automation in staging and add an analytics event to the pipeline dedupe job.

Jon K.: For commissions, Finance wants percent_split recorded on the opportunity when assigned. If we set Joint, record percent_split and attribution tags.

Ava G.: Agreed. Next steps: 
- Priya stage claim_token TTL + pending_confirm flow (due: today EOD)
- Luca update BrightCore marketplace UX to show TTL and non-owner-change behavior (due: tomorrow)
- Jon & Finance to confirm percent_split field semantics (due: 48h)
- Partnerships to publish a short one-pager: claim_token lifecycle + stitching rules (due: tomorrow)

Luca (BrightCore): We'll stop outbound touches on those six accounts and mark them reserved. We'll also add a tooltip in our onboarding.

Ava G.: Thanks. Closing when all automations + one-pager are live.

crm-bot: Notes added to accounts: "Marketplace claim_token received; claim_state=reserved; partnerships review required." :white_check_mark:
